guidance.opening:
一九二〇年秋天，波士顿。你坐在一位房东的小办公室里：他找人来谈一处总是租不出去的房子。桌上堆着租约和钥匙圈，窗外是灰扑扑的街声。

他探身过来，语速很快：「我是霍华德·克兰。上一户科斯塔一家走了，人进了疗养院，这房子再没人肯住。我按天付钱，只要有人肯去弄清楚怎么回事、好让我重新租出去。先别急着答应，我得知道你是谁。」

他敲了敲桌面，抬眼问：「你叫什么？平时靠什么吃饭？随便说说就行。」
guidance.advice: Occupations must use the listed names only. This is 1920s Boston: Journalist, Librarian, Lawyer, Private Investigator, Police Detective, Police Officer, Professor, Antiquarian, Author, Doctor of Medicine, Parapsychologist, and Clergy fit the public hire (look into why a house will not re-let after the last family left for an asylum). Engineer, Soldier, Military Officer, Athlete, Entertainer, Musician, Artist, Dilettante, Farmer, Drifter, Criminal, Missionary, Pilot, Zealot, Tribe Member, and Hacker are available if the player insists; Hacker is anachronistic—treat as a telegraph/radio tinkerer if used, do not invent stats. Useful training: Library Use, Law, Persuade, Spot Hidden, Listen, History, Occult (public rumor, not confirmed), Fast Talk, First Aid; English is assumed, Italian or Latin optional flavor only. Belongings: notebook, press card, medical bag, modest 1920s city clothes, flashlight—no keys, cash advance, or house address yet. Public involvement: answered a landlord’s call for help with an empty rental; daily pay is rumored, not yet agreed. Optional conversation (not a form): why they would look at an empty house, any Boston ties, whether they knew the last tenants—keep all of that player-invented and separate from authored facts (Costas left for an asylum; Crane is the landlord). Do not decide identity, accept the job, or hand over items.
guidance.handoff: The visitor is in Howard Crane’s Boston office, autumn 1920, hearing the public pitch about a house that will not re-let after the Costas left for an asylum. Identity and occupation are being asked; no commission has been accepted and no keys, address, or cash have been given. Continue from that meeting into character setup, then let play resume in the office when the card is ready.
